observation.consumer: Preliminary shortlist, final score comparison, target and assignment writers.
observation.cache_lifetime: Trace stack target lifecycle only where directly visible; no daily cadence claim.
observation.expected_signal: Exact instruction operands, sorting direction and tie handling, pool membership and final target write call chain.
observation.zero_sample_meaning: Missing direct xrefs do not rule out indirect or virtual execution.
observation.stop_condition: Bounded read-only EXE and script tracing from 0x185A780; preserve residual unknowns and never start CK3 or call native routines.
